result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a restaurant name truncated in the Fastest section and a broken discount badge showing “-0%” on a Popular card.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in “Fastest near you” is cut off mid-word (“Trattoria Piccol”), so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis only after a complete word so the name remains understandable.

issues.description: The pizza card under “Popular right now” shows a “-0%” badge, which looks broken or like missing promo data rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0%, or only show it when there is a meaningful non-zero discount.
